reason: I don't pay for anything before it is in my hands, and here I have to send the item price and their fee first to a new page I've never heard of. On top of that, 13,000 a kilo makes the cheap kids' things I buy not worth it compared to what I find in the local shops.
objection: Paying up front to a new service and then waiting two or three weeks hoping something shows up. I've heard of people losing their money exactly like this.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, so I pay nothing until the item is at my door, and a neighbour or relative who already used them and got their order.
